zones_unverified_region_idx.name: zones_unverified_region_idx
zones_unverified_region_idx.where: region_id is null and region_name_unverified is not null

zones_region_xor_unverified.name: zones_region_xor_unverified
zones_region_xor_unverified.value:
(region_id is not null and region_name_unverified is null)
          or (region_id is null and region_name_unverified is not null)

user_role_bindings_active_zone_idx.name: user_role_bindings_active_zone_idx
user_role_bindings_active_zone_idx.where: revoked_at is null and group_id is null and chapter_id is null

user_role_bindings_active_group_idx.name: user_role_bindings_active_group_idx
user_role_bindings_active_group_idx.where: revoked_at is null and group_id is not null and chapter_id is null

user_role_bindings_active_chapter_idx.name: user_role_bindings_active_chapter_idx
user_role_bindings_active_chapter_idx.where: revoked_at is null and group_id is null and chapter_id is not null

user_role_bindings_scope_shape.name: user_role_bindings_scope_shape
user_role_bindings_scope_shape.value:
(
        (role_scope = 'group'    and group_id is not null and chapter_id is null) or
        (role_scope = 'chapter'  and chapter_id is not null and group_id is null) or
        (role_scope = 'zone'     and group_id is null and chapter_id is null) or
        (role_scope = 'platform' and group_id is null and chapter_id is null)
      )

invitations_open_zone_unique_idx.name: invitations_open_zone_unique_idx
invitations_open_zone_unique_idx.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null and group_id is null and chapter_id is null

invitations_open_group_unique_idx.name: invitations_open_group_unique_idx
invitations_open_group_unique_idx.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null and group_id is not null and chapter_id is null

invitations_open_chapter_unique_idx.name: invitations_open_chapter_unique_idx
invitations_open_chapter_unique_idx.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null and group_id is null and chapter_id is not null

invitations_scope_shape.name: invitations_scope_shape
invitations_scope_shape.value:
(
        (role_code like 'group_%' and group_id is not null and chapter_id is null) or
        (role_code like 'chapter_%' and chapter_id is not null and group_id is null) or
        (role_code not like 'group_%' and role_code not like 'chapter_%' and group_id is null and chapter_id is null)
      )

member_addresses_one_primary_active_idx.name: member_addresses_one_primary_active_idx
member_addresses_one_primary_active_idx.where: is_primary = true and date_to is null

generated.as:
trim(both ' ' from regexp_replace(
        coalesce(first_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(middle_names, '') || ' ' || coalesce(last_name, ''),
        '\s+', ' ', 'g'
      ))

members_zone_active_idx.name: members_zone_active_idx
members_zone_active_idx.where: deleted_at is null and is_active = true

members_gender_valid.name: members_gender_valid
members_gender_valid.value: gender is null or gender in ('M', 'F', 'U')

import_files_chapter_service_event_check.name: import_files_chapter_service_event_check
import_files_chapter_service_event_check.value: "import_files"."chapter_id" is null or "import_files"."service_event_id" is not null

financial_targets_money_nonneg.name: financial_targets_money_nonneg
financial_targets_money_nonneg.value:
"financial_targets"."full_target" >= 0
          and ("financial_targets"."monthly_target" is null or "financial_targets"."monthly_target" >= 0)
          and ("financial_targets"."weekly_breakdown" is null or "financial_targets"."weekly_breakdown" >= 0)

financial_targets_counts_nonneg.name: financial_targets_counts_nonneg
financial_targets_counts_nonneg.value:
("financial_targets"."full_target_copies" is null or "financial_targets"."full_target_copies" >= 0)
          and ("financial_targets"."number_of_partners" is null or "financial_targets"."number_of_partners" >= 0)

platform_invitations_open_unique_idx.name: platform_invitations_open_unique_idx
platform_invitations_open_unique_idx.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null

audit_events_zone_scope_check.name: audit_events_zone_scope_check
audit_events_zone_scope_check.value:
(("audit_events"."action" like 'platform.%') and "audit_events"."zone_id" is null)
          or (("audit_events"."action" not like 'platform.%') and "audit_events"."zone_id" is not null)
